name: Kamdan's Cafe
tagline: Quick, affordable home cooking on North Ellis Street.
about: Kamdan's Cafe at 101 N Ellis St serves quick, affordable, quality home cooking in Groesbeck.
It's featured by Explore Limestone County and the Lake Limestone visitor guide. Closed Sundays.
sources: Description, address, phone, closed Sundays: https://www.facebook.com/KamdansCafe/
